certified_theorems.statement: Voynich running-text token forms obey representation-robust local graphotactic constraints and require at least second-order within-token context; third-order context is admitted only if its own smoothing-robust replay closes.
An explicit preselected page-family codebook is not part of the certified architecture; page-scale repertoire effects must be represented by mechanisms that survive deletion of that layer.
The observed physical-line ED1 attenuation is not certified as an independent avoidance rule once marginals and coarse vertical geometry are preserved.
Currier A/B may index real lower-dimensional distributional differences, but current manuscript support does not identify Currier as independent of section and Davis hand.
Across the frozen transcription family and smoothing grid, the local edge dependency is stronger across within-line SPACE than across physical LINE_BREAK.
Third-order within-token context is not admitted to the certified core because its incremental predictive gain is smoothing-dependent under the frozen sensitivity grid.

Under the current SG1.1 no-codebook architecture, a banded same-page exact-reuse channel over lags 2-64 improves the targeted lag-2-5 recurrence geometry; banding improves over uniform R64. The data do not establish that lag 1 must be excluded.

Two local conditional graphotactic effects survive independent heldout replay: q-context carries incremental k/t information beyond exact continuation tail, and i-run length carries incremental terminator information beyond short left context. The q effect is majority-transcription robust rather than universal.

The running-text junction architecture contains a representation-robust previous-token morphology/length residual and a stronger within-line SPACE than LINE_BREAK edge dependency. Complete exact previous-token closure is not certified: TTLI retains a small resolved exact-identity residual, while most other layers do not resolve a positive exact increment.

superseded_theorems.note: Requires space-edge, space>line, morphology residual and exact-identity closure lemmas. Superseded after v03 closure replay: SGK09 universal exact-identity closure failed; see SGT11.

R64 is scoped to the targeted recurrence coordinates because total joint improvement over mutation-off does not resolve. Superseded by SGT09_R64_CURRENT, which retests recurrence under the current SG1.1 no-codebook parent. Legacy sequential-mutation rejection remains unexported pending comparable replay.
